title: Splat video
description: A phone clip you can step into: the room is Gaussian splats, and the person is the original video, frame for frame at 30 fps, cut out with a soft matte and given depth. Drag to lean off the lens; sound, scrub and a splat look for the subject.
intent: Gets as close to 4DV.ai as one webcam allows: a sharp, native-frame-rate subject with no crossfade over a splat room built once, with exposure that follows the video, on a real player interface (play, scrub, speed, sound, look, back to lens) on the light palette.
